title: Smart Cast Actions
instructions:
Complete the `activateSubsystem` function. It takes a `Subsystem` parameter.

Use `is` to check the type and call the correct method:
- If it is a `DriveSubsystem`, call its `drive()` method
- If it is a `ShooterSubsystem`, call its `shoot()` method
- For any other type, print "No special action for {name}" using the `name` property

The classes are already defined. Do not change them.
hint: Use `if (sub is DriveSubsystem)` and then `sub.drive()` inside the block. Kotlin smart-casts `sub` to `DriveSubsystem` automatically after the `is` check.
